description: He wears a muted plum-purple long open-front coat over a cream tunic, with narrow gold-toned woven borders along the coat opening, cuffs and hem. Two round brooches are joined across the upper chest by a short metal link. The cream tunic has patterned bands at its split neckline, front and lower hem. A broad dark brown leather belt carries several circular ornaments, with a long hanging decorated tail. Brown trousers and tall dark brown leather boots complete the outfit. Fabrics have a substantial woven appearance; exact fibers are uncertain. His hands rest naturally behind his torso. The ensemble covers torso and limbs without headgear, armor or weapons.
